instructions.DCFREQ02: Fractional atomic exposure has a route-census magic but no generated browser request-layout module. The explorer names the raw route from the census and does not invent field offsets; render it only when Fractional's owning ABI generator emits that layout.
instructions.DCFRRQ03: Fractional retirement has a route-census magic but no generated browser request-layout module. The explorer preserves the census attribution and intentionally refuses to decode an unauthored body until Fractional publishes its generated ABI.
instructions.DCLCRH01: The Core/Custody retirement replay handoff is selected by this shared magic, but neither owner emits a browser request-layout authority. The explorer can identify both routes from the census and must not manufacture a body decoder.
instructions.DCLRLND1: Registry lineage successor declaration (registry/lineage_v1::process). Census identity only: no generated browser request-layout module emits its offsets, so the explorer names the route and refuses to invent a body decoder. Not this lane's route -- it became visible to this gate only when the basis lane regenerated routeCensus.ts, which had drifted 24 refusal codes and 5 magics behind the Rust. The gate did not fail to catch it; the mirror it reads was stale.
instructions.DCLTCCC1: Claim-check compaction (claims/claim_check_compaction_v1::process_compaction). Census identity only, no generated request-layout authority; same rule as DCFREQ02. Surfaced by the same routeCensus.ts regeneration and owned by the claim-check compaction lane, not this one.
instructions.DCLTCCO1: Claim-check escrow open (claims/claim_check_compaction_v1::process_open_escrow). Census identity only, no generated request-layout authority. Surfaced by the same routeCensus.ts regeneration; owned by the claim-check compaction lane.
instructions.DCLTCCR1: Claim-check redemption, selecting two routes under one magic (claim_check_redemption_v1::process_escrow_close and ::process_redemption). Census identity only, no generated request-layout authority, and a shared magic besides -- the DCLCRH01 situation. Surfaced by the same routeCensus.ts regeneration; owned by the claim-check compaction lane.
instructions.DCLTFCR1: Fractional claim-check redeem (crates/dclutch-claims/src/fractional_claim_check_v1.rs). Census identity only: no generated browser request-layout module emits its offsets, and its sibling DCLTFCC1 is already listed here for the same reason. Surfaced by the routeCensus.ts regeneration of 2026-09-01, which was itself overdue -- three ABI mirrors had gone stale while nine lanes landed. Render it when the Fractional ABI generator emits the layout; the explorer does not invent field offsets, and an orchestrator does not invent user-facing prose for a route whose semantics belong to the Fractional lane.
instructions.DCLSUPE1: Series unallocated-permit expiry request (crates/dclutch-market/src/series_unallocated_expiry_v1.rs). Census identity only, no generated request-layout module. Same regeneration, same owner as DCLSFTR1. Note the wire is owned by market-core-codec rather than a Series crate, so whoever renders it should take the offsets from the codec that owns them rather than restating them in TypeScript.
